scriptTimeout.description:
Script timeout in seconds.
This must be greater than jasmine.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_INTERVAL which is 1800s by default.
This must be less than hardcoded selenium helm value SE_NODE_SESSION_TIMEOUT which is 3600s by default.
